title: Escape The Ghosts
description: Determine if you can reach the target coordinate (x, y) before any ghosts, given their starting positions.

steps.note: Calculate distance from origin (0,0) to target (2,0): |2| + |0| = 2.
Start loop to check ghost at [1, 0].
Calculate distance from ghost [1, 0] to target [2, 0]: |1-2| + |0-0| = 1.
Compare ghost distance (1) with player distance (2). Since 1 <= 2, ghost intercepts.
